text:
anna_cs: Heads-up — prepping the Zenith QBR for next Tue. They called out runway and token burn as the main renewal risk.

mike_csm: Thanks. Do we have a simple daily token baseline + a short growth projection? Need something to show execs.

lina_onboarding: Onboarding milestones are green, but their batch import last month created big ingestion spikes that skew the avg. Still investigating why their batching logic retries so often.

raj_fin: Pulled 60-day export. Avg ~2.1M tokens/day, median 1.9M. One big spike to 5.3M on 2026-02-03 after the import. Uploaded CSV to the project folder: https://redwood.internal/zenith/reports/zenith-token-60d.csv

billing-bot: ALERT: zenith-prod has reached 85% of its monthly budget threshold. Details: https://billing.redwood/zenith/proj/alerts/4572 :warning:

anna_cs: Can we model the impact of enabling KV-prefix caching + switching gen routes to 4-bit quantized weights for non-critical models? Need an estimate for cost reduction vs any quality hit.

sam_eng: Quick sim done on a representative route: `sim: kv_cache=true quant=4bit` -> cost_factor ~0.72 (so ~28% token cost reduction), median latency +30ms, 95th pct +120ms. Tradeoffs look reasonable for their async job routes.

raj_fin: If that reduction holds, their monthly spend drops below the renewal sweet spot we want to present. I can run a conservative scenario (20% reduction) and an optimistic one (30%). Want numbers in $$ terms for the slide.

anna_cs: Perfect. I'll own the customer-facing narrative: emphasize predictable monthly run rate + enablement plan. @lina can you run a 50-prompt quality sweep for top-of-funnel flows to validate quant+cache?

lina_onboarding: On it. I'll run the prompts and baseline vs quantized results, capture any hallucination or formatting regressions, and post a short summary by EOD.

gaia_feedback: NPS alert: Zenith survey last week avg 7/10. Common notes: occasional hallucinations when prompts reference niche internal docs, and inconsistent outputs for bulk export. Link: https://feedback.redwood/zenith/notes/329

anna_cs: Good context — add retrieval/local-docs + prompt templates as mitigations in the plan. After Lina's quality check, I'll draft a one-page decision memo + two slides (cost delta + mitigations).

mike_csm: :thumbsup: No objections. Recommend we also show a projected 3-month burn chart with and without remediation to make runway clear. Can someone prep that for tomorrow's sync at 11am?

sam_eng: I'll export the sim numbers and a simple chart. Expect files in the project drive in ~90 mins.

raj_fin: I'll convert sim percentages to $ and run the conservative/optimistic scenarios.

anna_cs: Great. Thanks team — action items: Lina (quality sweep by EOD), Sam (sim + chart), Raj (dollarized scenarios), Anna (one-pager + slides). Sync tomorrow 11am to finalize deck. :calendar:
